LESSON: HOME TOWN OF BY THE END OF THE SUB STRAND, THE ●

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The 3.1 Wise men By the end of the Sub strand, the  Learners to read Matt 2:1-2
Topic 3.2: Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: where Jesus grew up Luke from?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name the home town of 2 lessons home towns to promote a sense of belonging

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. name the home town of 2 lessons home towns to promote a sense of belonging
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name the home town of 2 lessons home towns to promote a sense of belonging. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●.
2. Explain Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●.
4. Show that you can: name the home town of 2 lessons home towns to promote a sense of belonging
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: where Jesus grew up Luke from?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. name the home town of 2 lessons home towns to promote a sense of belonging

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
